mil5.5.5:1.2: Pubbe va 'haṃ manussabhūto samāno sattānaṃ aviheṭhakajātiko ahosin-ti.
mil5.5.5:1.4: Lomasakassapo nāma isi samāno anekasate pāṇe ghātayitvā vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yajīti.
mil5.5.5:1.6: Pubbe va 'haṃ manussabhūto samāno sattānaṃ aviheṭhakajātiko ahosin-ti, tena hi: Lomasakassapena isinā anekasate pāṇe ghātayitvā vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yajitan-ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.5.5:1.7: Yadi Lomasakassapena isinā anekasate pāṇe ghātayitvā vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yajitaṃ, tena hi: Pubbe va 'haṃ manussabhūto samāno sattānaṃ aviheṭhakajātiko ahosin-ti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.5.5:1.8: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavanuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.5.5:2.2: Pubbe va 'haṃ manussabhūto samāno sattānaṃ aviheṭhakajātiko ahosin-ti. Lomasakassapena ca isinā anekasate pāṇe ghātayitvā vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yajitaṃ; tañ-ca pana rāgavasena visaññinā, no sacetanenāti. -
mil5.5.5:3.1: Aṭṭh' ime bhante Nāgasena puggalā pāṇaṃ hananti,
mil5.5.5:3.3: ratto rāgavasena pāṇaṃ hanati, duṭṭho dosavasena pāṇaṃ hanati, mūḷho mohavasena pāṇaṃ hanati, mānī mānavasena pāṇaṃ hanati, luddho lobhavasena pāṇaṃ hanati, akiñcano jīvikatthāya pāṇaṃ hanati, bālo hassavasena pāṇaṃ hanati, rājā vinayanavasena pāṇaṃ hanati.
mil5.5.5:3.4: Ime kho bhante Nāgasena aṭṭha puggalā pāṇaṃ hananti.
mil5.5.5:3.5: Pakatikaṃ yeva bhante Nāgasena Bodhisattena katan-ti. -
mil5.5.5:3.6: Na mahārāja pakatikaṃ Bodhisattena kataṃ. Yadi mahārāja Bodhisatto pakatibhāvena oṇameyya mahāyaññaṃ yajituṃ, na-y-imaṃ gāthaṃ bhaṇeyya:
mil5.5.5:5.1: Evaṃvādī mahārāja Bodhisatto saha dassanena Candavatiyā rājakaññāya visaññī ahosi khittacitto ratto, visaññībhūto ākulākulo turitaturito tena vikkhitta-bhantaluḷita-cittena mahatimahā-pasughāta-galaruhira-sañcayaṃ vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yaji.
mil5.5.5:6.1: Yathā mahārāja ummattako khittacitto jalitam-pi jātavedaṃ akkamati, kupitam-pi āsīvisaṃ gaṇhāti, mattam-pi hatthiṃ upeti, samuddam-pi atīradassī pakkhandati, candanikam-pi oḷigallam-pi omaddati, kaṇṭakādhānam-pi abhirūhati, papāte pi patati, asucim-pi bhakkheti, naggo pi ratiyā carati, aññam-pi bahuvidhaṃ akiriyaṃ karoti;
mil5.5.5:6.2: evameva kho mahārāja Bodhisatto saha dassanena Candavatiyā rājakaññāya visaññī ahosi khittacitto, visaññībhūto ākulākulo turitaturito tena vikkhitta-bhanta-luḷita-cittena mahatimahā-pasughāta-galaruhira-sañcayaṃ vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yaji.
mil5.5.5:7.1: Khittacittena mahārāja kataṃ pāpaṃ diṭṭhadhamme pi na mahāsāvajjaṃ hoti, samparāye vipākena pi no tathā.
mil5.5.5:7.2: Idha mahārāja koci ummattako vajjham-āpajjeyya, tassa tumhe kiṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārethāti.
mil5.5.5:7.3: Ko bhante ummattakassa daṇḍo bhavissati, taṃ mayaṃ pothāpetvā nīharāpema, eso va tassa daṇḍo ti. -
mil5.5.5:7.4: Iti kho mahārāja ummattakassa aparādhe daṇḍo pi na bhavati, tasmā ummattakassa kate pi na doso bhavati, satekiccho.
mil5.5.5:7.5: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Lomasakassapo isi saha dassanena Candavatiyā rājakaññāya visaññī ahosi khittacitto ratto, visaññībhūto visaṭapayāto ākulākulo turitaturito tena vikkhitta-bhanta-luḷita-cittena mahatimahā-pasughāta-galaruhira-sañcayaṃ vājapeyyaṃ mahāyaññaṃ yaji.
mil5.5.5:7.6: Yadā ca pana pakaticitto ahosi paṭiladdhasati, tadā puna-d-eva pabbajitvā pañcābhiññāyo nibbattetvā brahmalokūpago ahosīti. -
mil5.5.5:7.7: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evametaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
